definitions: Body reaction and sprung truck frame weight are separate input forces. Unsprung weight is added once in each axle balance.
Full truck mass, not unsprung mass alone, is subtracted when calculating body-to-truck bearing force from whole-coach mass.
Nominal gauge, wheel contact spacing, bearing centers and spring centers are different interfaces.
Two coils aggregate only if both have the same lower/upper displacement; separated spring seats may require independent stations.
next_actual_geometry_requirement: Obtain controlled wheel/bearing/axlebox/D1/brake envelope and accepted full-truck mass/load/motion package before mount/guide/body-support/coil/damper sizes. This model supplies a missing mechanics method, not those interfaces.
